---
title: "Variant-aware Transcriptome Assembly"
description: "Cluster long RNA reads into transcripts, correct sequencing errors, re-cluster the corrected reads, build one consensus sequence per transcript, restore degraded ends, and call RNA variants."
---

This pipeline assembles full-length transcripts directly from long-read RNA sequencing data.
Reads are clustered into their transcripts of origin based on their splice junctions and variants,
corrected against their own clusters, re-clustered, collapsed into one consensus sequence per transcript,
and stitched to the reference transcripts where their ends are degraded. The assembly is variant-aware.
Each cluster's variant calls decide which variants correction keeps and removes.
RNA variants and transcript structures are then identified from the assembled transcripts.

The assembly pipeline relies two-pass clustering because sequencing errors near splice junctions can
shift the reported junction coordinates and fork one transcript into near-duplicate clusters.
Pass 1 clusters the raw reads and uses each cluster's own variant calls to remove those errors; pass 2 re-clusters
the corrected reads so the forks merge and a consensus is built once per transcript.

External tools you'll need alongside exacto:

- [`Minimap2`](https://github.com/lh3/minimap2) — long-read RNA alignment
- [`Samtools`](https://www.htslib.org/) — BAM sorting and indexing

Every minimap2 step below uses the same options. `--cs` is required: Exacto reads variants
from the `cs` tag.

## Step 1. Align the RNA reads

```bash
minimap2 -ax splice:hq -uf --cs --eqx -Y -L --secondary=no --splice-flank=no \
    reference_genome.fasta tumor_rna.fastq.gz \
    | samtools sort -o tumor_rna.sorted.bam
samtools index tumor_rna.sorted.bam
```

## Step 2. Cluster the reads (pass 1)

Group reads by their transcript of origin and call variants within each cluster. Use
`--preset pb` for PacBio HiFi reads or `--preset ont` for Oxford Nanopore reads.
`cluster-rna-reads` removes unspliced RNAs first, as
[`remove-unspliced-rnas`](../cli/remove-unspliced-rnas.qmd) does
(`--remove-unspliced-rnas no` turns this off when the input is already filtered):

```bash
exacto cluster-rna-reads \
    --bam-file tumor_rna.sorted.bam \
    --bai-file tumor_rna.sorted.bam.bai \
    --reference-genome-fasta-file reference_genome.fasta \
    --reference-gene-annotation-file gencode.gtf.gz \
    --reference-gene-annotation-source gencode \
    --reference-gene-annotation-assembly hg38 \
    --reference-gene-annotation-version v45 \
    --output-dir pass1/ \
    --output-prefix tumor_pass1 \
    --preset pb
```

::: {.callout-note}
Every output file is named only from `--output-dir` and `--output-prefix`. Give the two
`cluster-rna-reads` runs distinct prefixes (`tumor_pass1` and `tumor_pass2` here), or the second
run overwrites the first.
:::

## Step 3. Correct sequencing errors

Correct each read against its pass-1 cluster. Each read is rewritten to the reference plus its
cluster's called alleles: a base, insertion or deletion that disagrees with them is corrected, and
at a called variant the read takes the called allele. Uncalled insertions and deletions longer than
`--max-correctable-event-len` and uncalled terminal soft clips are kept as sequenced; read ends are
trimmed to annotated exons only with `--trim-transcript-ends`. The corrected reads are written to
`pass1/tumor_pass1_exacto_rna_corrected_reads.fastq.gz` (BGZF, with per-base qualities and the
original read names):

```bash
exacto correct-rna-reads \
    --bam-file tumor_rna.sorted.bam \
    --clusters-tsv-file pass1/tumor_pass1_exacto_rna_clusters.tsv \
    --cluster-reference-transcripts-tsv-file pass1/tumor_pass1_exacto_rna_clusters_reference_transcripts.tsv \
    --cluster-splice-junctions-tsv-file pass1/tumor_pass1_exacto_rna_clusters_splice_junctions.tsv \
    --cluster-variants-tsv-file pass1/tumor_pass1_exacto_rna_clusters_variants_passed.tsv \
    --reference-gene-annotation-file gencode.gtf.gz \
    --reference-gene-annotation-source gencode \
    --reference-gene-annotation-assembly hg38 \
    --reference-gene-annotation-version v45 \
    --output-dir pass1/ \
    --output-prefix tumor_pass1
```

## Step 4. Align the corrected reads

```bash
minimap2 -ax splice:hq -uf --cs --eqx -Y -L --secondary=no --splice-flank=no \
    reference_genome.fasta pass1/tumor_pass1_exacto_rna_corrected_reads.fastq.gz \
    | samtools sort -o pass1/tumor_pass1_exacto_rna_corrected.sorted.bam
samtools index pass1/tumor_pass1_exacto_rna_corrected.sorted.bam
```

## Step 5. Re-cluster the corrected reads (pass 2)

Clusters that pass 1 forked on junction-shifting errors now merge into one cluster per transcript.
Use `--preset corrected`, whose error rates are those of exacto-corrected reads, and pass the
pass-1 variant calls as the allow list: correction has already removed every small variant pass 1
did not call, so a pass-2 call that matches no pass-1 call fails as `not_in_allowed_list`:

```bash
exacto cluster-rna-reads \
    --bam-file pass1/tumor_pass1_exacto_rna_corrected.sorted.bam \
    --bai-file pass1/tumor_pass1_exacto_rna_corrected.sorted.bam.bai \
    --reference-genome-fasta-file reference_genome.fasta \
    --reference-gene-annotation-file gencode.gtf.gz \
    --reference-gene-annotation-source gencode \
    --reference-gene-annotation-assembly hg38 \
    --reference-gene-annotation-version v45 \
    --output-dir pass2/ \
    --output-prefix tumor_pass2 \
    --preset corrected \
    --allowed-variants-tsv-file pass1/tumor_pass1_exacto_rna_clusters_variants_passed.tsv
```

## Step 6. Build one consensus sequence per transcript

`determine-rna-consensus` finds each pass-2 cluster's reads by name in the FASTQ, so pair the
pass-2 clusters TSV with the corrected FASTQ those reads came from:

```bash
exacto determine-rna-consensus \
    --tsv-file pass2/tumor_pass2_exacto_rna_clusters.tsv \
    --fastq-file pass1/tumor_pass1_exacto_rna_corrected_reads.fastq.gz \
    --output-dir pass2/ \
    --output-prefix tumor_pass2
```

## Step 7. Align the consensus sequences

```bash
minimap2 -ax splice:hq -uf --cs --eqx -Y -L --secondary=no --splice-flank=no \
    reference_genome.fasta pass2/tumor_pass2_exacto_rna_consensus.fasta \
    | samtools sort -o pass2/tumor_pass2_exacto_rna_consensus.sorted.bam
samtools index pass2/tumor_pass2_exacto_rna_consensus.sorted.bam
```

## Step 8. Restore degraded transcript ends

PolyA-capture cDNA loses 5' sequence to degradation, and 3' ends are often the product of internal
priming; both truncate open reading frames. `stitch-reference-transcripts` stitches the sequence of
the best-matching reference transcript onto each degraded end and records every stitch in its TSV.
An end that no reference transcript fits is left as it is.

```bash
exacto stitch-reference-transcripts \
    --bam-file pass2/tumor_pass2_exacto_rna_consensus.sorted.bam \
    --reference-genome-fasta-file reference_genome.fasta \
    --reference-gene-annotation-file gencode.gtf.gz \
    --reference-gene-annotation-source gencode \
    --reference-gene-annotation-assembly hg38 \
    --reference-gene-annotation-version v45 \
    --output-dir stitched/ \
    --output-prefix tumor
```

## Step 9. Align the stitched transcripts

The stitched sequences no longer match the coordinates of the consensus alignment, so they are
aligned again before variant calling:

```bash
minimap2 -ax splice:hq -uf --cs --eqx -Y -L --secondary=no --splice-flank=no \
    reference_genome.fasta stitched/tumor_exacto_stitched_transcripts.fasta \
    | samtools sort -o stitched/tumor_exacto_stitched_transcripts.sorted.bam
samtools index stitched/tumor_exacto_stitched_transcripts.sorted.bam
```

## Step 10. Call RNA variants

Call RNA variants and transcript structures, and predict nonsense-mediated decay, for each
assembled transcript. `--dna-variants-tsv-files` (optional) marks each RNA variant that a DNA
variant call explains with that call's origin (germline or somatic):

```bash
exacto call-rna-transcript-vars \
    --bam-file stitched/tumor_exacto_stitched_transcripts.sorted.bam \
    --reference-genome-fasta-file reference_genome.fasta \
    --reference-gene-annotation-file gencode.gtf.gz \
    --reference-gene-annotation-source gencode \
    --reference-gene-annotation-assembly hg38 \
    --reference-gene-annotation-version v45 \
    --output-dir rna_variants/ \
    --output-prefix tumor
```

### Optional: quantify transcript abundances

```bash
exacto quantify-rna-abundances \
    --clusters-tsv-file pass2/tumor_pass2_exacto_rna_clusters.tsv \
    --cluster-reference-matches-tsv-file pass2/tumor_pass2_exacto_rna_clusters_reference_transcripts.tsv \
    --cluster-splice-junctions-tsv-file pass2/tumor_pass2_exacto_rna_clusters_splice_junctions.tsv \
    --cluster-variants-tsv-file pass2/tumor_pass2_exacto_rna_clusters_variants_passed.tsv \
    --consensus-rna-reference-matches-tsv-file rna_variants/tumor_exacto_assembled_transcript_reference_transcript_matches.tsv \
    --output-dir abundances/ \
    --output-prefix tumor
```

## Outputs

| File | Produced by | Description |
|:-----|:------------|:------------|
| `pass1/tumor_pass1_exacto_rna_corrected_reads.fastq.gz` | `correct-rna-reads` | Error-corrected reads with their original names and per-base qualities (BGZF) |
| `pass2/tumor_pass2_exacto_rna_clusters.tsv` | `cluster-rna-reads` | Read-to-cluster assignments of the corrected reads |
| `pass2/tumor_pass2_exacto_rna_clusters_variants_passed.tsv` | `cluster-rna-reads` | Variants called within the pass-2 clusters |
| `pass2/tumor_pass2_exacto_rna_consensus.tsv` | `determine-rna-consensus` | One consensus record per cluster, with its read names |
| `pass2/tumor_pass2_exacto_rna_consensus.fasta` | `determine-rna-consensus` | One consensus sequence per cluster, named by cluster ID |
| `stitched/tumor_exacto_stitched_transcripts.tsv` | `stitch-reference-transcripts` | Stitched sequences and the stitch made at each end |
| `stitched/tumor_exacto_stitched_transcripts.fasta` | `stitch-reference-transcripts` | Stitched transcript sequences |
| `rna_variants/tumor_exacto_assembled_transcript_variants.tsv` | `call-rna-transcript-vars` | RNA variants per transcript |
| `rna_variants/tumor_exacto_assembled_transcript_model_alignments.tsv` | `call-rna-transcript-vars` | Each transcript's structure against the genome |
| `rna_variants/tumor_exacto_assembled_transcript_nmd_predictions.tsv` | `call-rna-transcript-vars` | Nonsense-mediated decay prediction per open reading frame |
| `abundances/tumor_exacto_rna_abundances.tsv` | `quantify-rna-abundances` | Abundance per cluster |
